claims.text: Thompson Nashville is a boutique hotel in The Gulch neighborhood near Broadway.

findings.quote: Thompson Nashville, our boutique hotel located in The Gulch neighborhood near Broadway

claims.text: The hotel is just steps from Broadway's honky-tonks, Bridgestone Arena, Music Row, the Frist Art Museum and Geodis Park.

findings.quote: located just steps from art and culture — Broadway’s Honky Tonks, Bridgestone Arena, Music Row, the Frist Art Museum, Geodis Park, and endless boutiques

claims.text: Every guest room and suite has floor-to-ceiling windows, sliding barn doors and a rainfall shower.

findings.quote: Take in the city through the floor-to-ceiling windows in each of our luxury hotel’s 224 guest rooms and suites, where sliding barn doors, chic mid-century-inspired furnishings and rainfall showers

claims.text: Rooms have hardwood floors, and king beds are dressed in Sferra linens.

findings.quote: unwind in the comforts of your room featuring a king bed with luxury Sferra linens, hardwood floors, and a refreshing rainfall shower
findings.note: hardwood floors and Sferra linens on king beds

findings.quote: Wake up wrapped in luxury Sferra linens in your king bed

claims.text: Marsh House, on the ground floor, focuses on responsibly sourced seafood and Southern-inspired cuisine, with a raw bar.

findings.quote: Located on the ground floor, Marsh House highlights responsibly sourced seafood and Southern-inspired cuisine, with a seasonal menu and standout raw bar.

claims.text: Marsh House's wine list features more than 400 labels.

findings.quote: The wine list features more than 400 labels.

claims.text: Killebrew Coffee is the lobby-level coffee shop, with a pastry counter.

findings.quote: Start your day off in our boutique hotel’s lobby-level coffee shop, Killebrew Coffee, in The Gulch.
as well as the pastry counter, brimming with treats like croissants, muffins and stuffed cookies

claims.text: In-room dining from Marsh House is available day, night and overnight.

findings.quote: Enjoy all the benefits of Marsh House’s delectable menu offerings from the comfort of your own room or suite. Day or night, or even overnight

claims.text: Dogs are welcome at no additional charge.

findings.quote: We welcome dogs at no additional charge.

claims.text: Valet parking is available at the hotel entrance, with in-and-out privileges.

findings.quote: Valet parking is available at our downtown Nashville hotel entrance, including in-and-out privileges.

claims.text: Kids stay free, cribs can be requested, and connecting rooms are available.

findings.quote: Kids stay free at the Thompson Nashville, and guests can request cribs if necessary. There are also connecting rooms available

claims.text: The hotel rises 12 stories, and its decor is midcentury-modern inspired, with natural wood and neutral colors.

findings.quote: The Thompson Nashville rises 12 stories
Hotel decor is midcentury-modern–inspired, which means you’ll be treated to minimalist interiors with lots of natural wood and neutral colors

claims.text: L.A. Jackson is the top-floor indoor-outdoor rooftop bar with views of The Gulch, craft cocktails and shareable bites; DJs play on select weekends.

findings.quote: Head to the top floor of Thompson Nashville, where L.A. Jackson pairs indoor and outdoor rooftop views of The Gulch with craft cocktails, local and regional beers, and shareable bites. DJs set the tone on select weekends.
findings.note: top floor, views, cocktails, bites, DJs

findings.quote: up on our lively indoor-outdoor rooftop bar and dining, L.A. Jackson

claims.text: Guest room minibars are stocked with local treats including Tennessee spirits, and each room has a cocktail shaker.

findings.quote: Guest room mini bars are stocked with local treats and ingredients, including Tennessee spirits. You can use the cocktail shaker in your room

claims.text: The famous wings mural is just across the street from the hotel.

findings.quote: the famous wings are just across the street from the Thompson

claims.text: The lobby floor is made from reclaimed wood from the neighborhood.

findings.quote: including the lobby floor, which is made from reclaimed wood from the neighborhood

claims.text: Each floor has hydration stations with filtered sparkling and still water.

findings.quote: Hydration stations on each floor with filtered sparkling and still water.

claims.text: A daily destination fee is applied to each room.

findings.quote: A daily destination fee of $30.00 (subject to change) is applied to each room of your stay

findings.quote: 21 and over.
